function: Semi-supervised HetGNN jointly selects active APs (on/off) and allocates downlink powers P_mk to minimize total power under SINR and CRB sensing-accuracy constraints (p. 1, 3-4).
system: Cell-free massive MIMO ISAC downlink: M=30-80 dual-function APs (scalar channels), K=5-20 UEs, T sensing receivers, one static target; 1900 MHz carrier, 20 MHz; no RIS (p. 1-2, 5).
method: Semi-supervised heterogeneous GNN (three layers, MLP message passing); loss combines MSE/BCE on modified Branch-and-Bound labels with unsupervised constraint penalties; trained on multiple (K, M) settings (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Custom simulator for training and testing: nodes uniform in a 500 m circle; uncorrelated Rayleigh fading, path loss -120.9-37.6log10(d), 7 dB shadowing; labels from modified Branch-and-Bound (p. 5).
test_conditions: Trained on K in {5,10,15,20}, M in {30,50,80}; tested on unseen data: K=5-20 at M=50 (Fig. 3) and four (M,K) cases in Table II, including K=6 (p. 5-6).
baselines: Non-learned: modified Branch-and-Bound with relaxed constraints, full-AP with relaxed constraints, decoupled AP-selection and scaling heuristic; learned: DDPG actor-critic, separate model per scenario (p. 5).
metrics: Total transmit power (W) versus number of UEs; average number of active APs; runtime in seconds (Table II); power reduction percentages (p. 5-6).
complexity: Order O(4L((M+K+T)F^2 + M(K+T))) for forward plus backward pass of L-layer HetGNN; model-based solver O((2MK)^3) per iteration; HetGNN runtime 0.08-0.12 s versus 87-6035 s modified BB (p. 4, 6).
q1_support: p. 5: "All the channel gains obey the uncorrelated Rayleigh fading model" with a self-defined path loss (FSPL = -120.9 - 37.6 log10(d)) not attributed to 3GPP; no TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "we train the HetGNN model on the data using multiple system settings of K = [5, 10, 15, 20] and M = [30, 50, 80]"; p. 6: "at M = 30 and K = 6, HetGNN consumes only 4.04 W", a number of UEs outside the training list.
q3_support: p. 5: "Decoupled method", "Full AP + Constraint relaxed" and the modified Branch-and-Bound are non-learned; p. 5: "Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)" is the learned baseline; p. 6: "Although the DDPG model outperforms the modified-BB method", all compared on total power.
q4_support: p. 4: "the total computational complexity is given by" O(4L((M+K+T)F^2 + M(K+T))), Eq. (15); p. 6: "compared to 6035.32 s for the modified BB method" reports measured runtimes in Table II.
q5_support: p. 5: "The model is trained on various generated scenarios and evaluation on unseen data", all from the authors' own simulator; no code or data link or DOI, only a link to the third-party CVX toolbox (p. 6, ref. [16]).
notes: Included, area 5: learned power allocation and AP activation serving sensing and communication in cell-free massive MIMO ISAC. AP on/off alone would be network management, but the HetGNN also outputs the downlink powers P_mk, so above_phy passes. q2 rests on the single K=6 row in Table II (other rows lie in the training grid) and the paper does not label it unseen; reviewer may confirm.
